# イラスト依頼文：ガリレオ（ChatGPT web、1チャット4枚まで、1行で送る）

共通：画風＝落ち着いた夜の紺色と、あたたかい金色のアクセント。絵画風の semi-realistic イラスト。**画像内に文字・数字・ロゴを入れない。実在人物の顔を描かない（人物は描かない）。**横長（16:9）。文字を重ねるので、全体に暗めで、細かい模様を入れすぎない。

保存名（assets/galileo/）：art_intro / art_hall / art_books / art_gallery / art_sky / thumb_art

## チャット1
1. art_intro：Dark navy night illustration, an old brass telescope on a wooden stand by a window under a starry sky, a single candle glowing warmly on a table with blank parchment, calm thoughtful mood, painterly semi-realistic style, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, wide 16:9 composition, dark overall with warm gold accents
2. art_hall：Dark painterly illustration of a large empty stone hall of the 1600s with tall arched windows, a long wooden table and empty high-backed chairs, shafts of moonlight, no people, no text, no letters, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy and warm gold tones
3. art_books：Dark painterly illustration of an old library desk with a stack of antique leather-bound books and one open book with blank yellowed pages, an inkwell with a quill, candlelight, no people, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy with warm gold accents
4. art_gallery：Dark painterly illustration of a quiet museum gallery at night with an ornate empty gilded picture frame on the wall lit by a small spotlight, the canvas inside dark and blank, polished floor reflections, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy with warm gold lights
